notes: Events are participants with at least one adverse event, not total adverse-event episodes. Safety analysis was as-treated; ten participants who took no study drug were excluded. Randomised arm sizes were 246 and 231, whereas the explicitly stated safety denominators were 245 and 222. Separately, the source reports 24 and 12 total AEs, 3 and 5 suspected drug-related AEs, and 9 and 3 serious AEs in the S boulardii and placebo groups, respectively. The window is the general trial regimen and follow-up; a separate AE-specific assessment window is not stated.
